classification_notes: Runtime/bootstrap -> settings_stations; Channel connectivity -> station_keys; update/data-directory -> updater_data_recovery.

S1-T4 runtime contract closeout, S1-T5 settings/stations, station-key ordinary, changes/logs, collector ordinary groups, routing/health reads, pricing reads, proxy workspace reads, routing capability/model-alias mutations, pricing mutations, local-routing reorder, endpoint ping, proxy lifecycle, updater backend reads, settings bootstrap, updater/data-recovery, collector capture ordinary commands, and S1-T6 streaming Channel migrate all 120 commands.
test_station_key_connectivity remains the single Channel command and now uses strict DTO input plus a versioned detach-only streaming envelope.
No command proves an application-owned operation key; idempotent_with_key count is zero.
scan_remote_station_keys is an idempotent mutation because it atomically replaces the local remote-key snapshot and matching key metadata; transport retry remains disabled.
create_station is NonIdempotent: transport retry is disabled and ambiguous post-dispatch rejection becomes typed ResultUnknownError.

record_capture_event is intentionally capture-only, not missing from ACL, and must not be granted to main-window. finish_web_authorization_session is a capture-specific command also callable by the main-window manual UI; capture remote windows receive only the separate record-capture-event permission and cannot call station/key/settings/proxy/updater/data-recovery commands.
Empty frontend_callers means no literal caller in requested API/query directories.
Audit artifact only: Stage 1 command-contract ledger has no remaining legacy or pilot placeholders; Stage 2 entry still requires the full Stage 1 Gate command set to be rerun on this revision.
